The fix handles the null vmService case gracefully. Since both `'o'` and `'O'` route to the same `residentRunner.debugTogglePlatform()` call (lines 1726-1728), the behavior is automatically consistent across both keys.

The change:
- Guards against a null `vmService` after the existing `supportsServiceProtocol`/`isRunningDebug` check, before any `vmService!` dereference (which would have thrown).
- Logs `'Platform toggle is not supported for this device.'` via the status logger and returns `false` cleanly instead of crashing.
